answer: A farm running 200 keys thus forfeits that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation trivial. Because the umber stake is held until the orchard settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the basalt audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 24% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer burns proportionally more than endorsing a low-cost one. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
